sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The Huntik team, joined by LeBlanche, used a deck boat to follow the Dragon's Breath from the coast of England to Avalon. When it neared Avalon's shore, it became ensnared in the vines of Dark Dryad, forcing the team to jump from the boat before it hit the rocks and exploded. [Knight of the Willblade]

In Baja California, Mexico, the Huntik team later used another deck boat to reach the Sea of Cortés, before they dived down to Hernán Cortés' vault. [The Power of Umbra]

==History==

In [[Baja California, Mexico]], the Huntik team later used another deck boat to reach the [[Sea of Cortés]], before they dived down to [[Hernán Cortés' vault]]. {{source|The Power of Umbra}}
